title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E18 — Watts Side Story
Fred is shocked when Lamont dates the sister of their Puerto Rican neighbor, Julio. The date becomes farcical when Fred's ploys to stop the date fail and he follows the couple -- in disguise.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E19 — Pops 'N Pals
Feeling jealous and neglected, Fred conjures up several ruses that will hopefully keep Lamont from spending so much time with Julio.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E20 — The Infernal Triangle
Lamont is upset when Fred announces that he plans to marry a young woman he has just met. When the young lady arrives at the house, Lamont is shocked to be face-to-face with one of his old girlfriends.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E21 — Home Sweet Home For The Aged
Fred is caught up in a series of frustrating situations when he becomes a resident of a senior citizens' home. Fred is put in the home by Lamont, who plans to work his way around the world on a tramp steamer and doesn't want to leave his father alone.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E22 — Uncle George And Aunt Louise
Louise makes it very clear to George that she doesn't want another child in the house, but he makes sure she gets one anyway, and he lives to regret it.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E23 — George And Louise In A Bind
A burglar ties up George and Louise and gives them a night to remember in a special 90-minute episode. As they wait to be rescued, George and Louise re-live (by flashback) some of their most unforgettable and hilarious experiences.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E26 — Jenny's Thesis
Jenny Jefferson's thesis research on street gangs teaches her and her family a horrifying lesson in life...and death.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E1 — Louise's Painting
George riled by bare facts.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E4 — How Slowly They Forget
George's unexpected offer to help Louise and Allan cut through the red tape that's delaying the move of the Help Center turns into more trouble than anyone is prepared to handle.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S3 E19 — Phyllis Diller, The Committee
Flip seeks a loan; Phyllis does her classic stand-up and comedy troupe The Committee do hilarious sketches.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S3 E20 — The Amazing Kreskin, Diana Sands, Dom DeLuise
Kreskin performs magic and acts in a sketch w/Flip & Diana Sands; Dom DeLuise battles Geraldine in the grocery store.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S1 E14 — ShaNaNa, Burl Ives, Slim Gaillard
Santa Claus (Ives) drops by the gas station; Gaillard & Ives do The Night Before Christmas and Rev. Leroy tells ShaNaNa about Scrooge.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S1 E17 — Muhammad Ali, Bobby Darin, Lily Tomlin
The boxing champ makes poetic predictions for his Joe Frazier fight; Tomlin’s a health nut; Flip & Bobby do a vaudeville bit.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E5 — James Baldwin - Part 2
The second installment in a special, two-part program featuring James Baldwin.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E6 — Bill Withers/Mae Jackson
Featured guest Bill Withers sings hit single, "Ain't No Sunshine" and other selections from his album, Just As I Am.  In another segment, young poetess Mae Jackson reads from her own works.

title: Webster
description:
S6 E5 — The Election
Webster runs the campaign of a class presidential candidate.

title: Webster
description:
S6 E6 — The Crush
A teenage boy that Katherine gives romantic advice secretly has a crush on her.

title: Webster
description:
S6 E7 — The Chelsea Cat
A friend of George and Katherine's turns out to be a cat burglar.

title: Webster
description:
S6 E8 — Take My Cousin, Please
Aunt Charlotte surprises Papa and Webster by announcing her intention to adopt.

title: Webster
description:
S6 E9 — Heaven
Webster's sorrow over the death of his pet increases when he's told animals don't go to heaven.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S5 E21 — Shoeless
With the help of her grandfather's horse-drawn carriage and a pair of borrowed shoes from Tia, Tamera stars in a '90s-style Cinderella story.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S5 E22 — Graduation
The twins are graduating from high school, but the future doesn't look as bright for Tia's boyfriend Tyreke, who's having a tough time getting his high school equivalency degree.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S6 E1 — Home Sweet Dorm
Tia and Tamera are off to college but they encounter housing problems during their search for the perfect dorm situation; Ray looks forward to remodeling their room.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S6 E2 — Stop In The Name Of Fun
All work and no play makes Tia a dull girl... until Tamera signs her up for a spot on an MTV talent show!

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S6 E3 — Home Court Advantage
At Tamera's urging, Lisa hires a new assistant, Todd Banks, an attractive young male graduate who turns out to be lazy on the job. After a number of screw-ups, Lisa fires him.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E4 — Mis-Directed Study
Moesha is flying high after she gets a job tutoring one of the basketball team’s star players until she finds out what kind of game he really wants to play.
